strategy_notes: Localized the target bowl by agentview semantic relation (black patterned bowl elevated on the cookie box) and accepted a wrist refinement at step 1; localized the destination as the red-ring white plate. Command sequence: move_to above target bowl at [0.0566, 0.0404, 1.08] with gripper open; pi0_pick 'pick up the black patterned bowl' with max_chunks 20, lift_thresh 0.05, gripper_closed_thresh 0.06; set_gripper +1 for 8 steps; carry to [0.065, 0.21, 1.08]; descend/correct to [0.045, 0.218, 1.0] then [0.02, 0.225, 0.965]; release for 30 steps. Release left the bowl visibly on the plate but predicate false, so with the object upright and close to the plate center, moved open gripper up to [0.02, 0.225, 1.08], then issued a short local pi0_pick 'pick up the black patterned bowl' with max_chunks 12; this close-pose contact/lift triggered libero_terminated true at step 10.
